title: Daffy Duck Is Back on the Big Screen
summary:
Daffy Duck is back on the big screen! A new Looney Tunes short called 'Daffy Season' plays before 'The Cat in the Hat,' which opens Friday from Warner Bros. Pictures. It is the first new Looney Tunes short since 'Daffy's Rhapsody' in 2012.

The seven-minute short stars Daffy Duck, voiced by Eric Bauza. Daffy turns his beak up at his fellow Tunes, who love soccer. Jeff Bergman voices Bugs Bunny, Gabriel Iglesias voices Speedy Gonzales, and Jeannie Tirado voices Lola Bunny. Todd Wilderman and Hamish Grieve directed the short.

The studio says this is Bauza's final Looney Tunes movie. Over 15 years, he became the main voice of modern Looney Tunes, playing Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Elmer Fudd, Foghorn Leghorn, Tweety, and Porky Pig. He also starred in 'Coyote vs. Acme.'

Sadly, Bauza died at his home in Los Angeles on October 25. Producer Susan Rogers said he helped bring Looney Tunes back, and no one can replace him. A GoFundMe page will help his son, Ryker Bauza, and Ryker's mother, Jessica Borutski.
why_it_matters: If you love cartoons, this is a chance to see a brand-new Daffy Duck short on the big screen, just like kids did with cartoons long ago.
